release: War Room OS V7.9 Final Proven Core
strategy_sleeve: User-authorized dedicated sleeve; not automatically the user's whole account
observation_rule: Use only the most recent completed calendar-month S&P 500 close and its trailing 10 completed-month simple moving average.

signal_rule.equity: Completed monthly S&P 500 close is at or above SMA10
signal_rule.cash: Completed monthly S&P 500 close is below SMA10

execution_rule: Execute once during the first regular US market session after month-end. No intramonth override.
cost_guard: No order when estimated one-way total execution cost exceeds 25 bps.
data_policy: Dual-source-confirmed completed-month S&P 500 data only: FRED SP500 plus Yahoo-distributed ^GSPC. Manual/bundled observations are audit-only. Missing, stale, duplicated, gapped, future-dated, non-positive or mismatched data fail closed to NO ORDER.
proof_scope: Historically confirmed broad-US-equity drawdown and left-tail reduction under the frozen monthly long/cash rule and tested 10/25 bps one-way cost assumptions.
claim_limit: No guarantee of future profit, no exact crash-date prediction and no permission for individual stocks, IHSG, FX, commodities or crypto.
